summary: Gilat Satellite Networks (through its subsidiary Wavestream) filed a 6-K disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire Comtech's Satellite Space Communications segment for $157.5M cash, with a $10M advance payment and remaining $147.5M at closing. Subject to HSR, CFIUS, and other customary conditions; completion expected within 12 months, extendable three months for regulatory approval. No break fee specified but advance payment may be non-returnable if antitrust approvals fail. Watch CFIUS timeline and any counter-bid or regulatory pushback as risk-arb angle.
